summary.en: Defaults for the interface: which permission tier a new session starts in, which language and theme to use, and which model names titles. Most fields are changed in Settings → General; editing this section by hand is usually only for bulk resets.
summary.zh: 界面的默认值：新会话从哪一档权限开始、用什么语言和主题、标题用哪个模型起名。多数字段在「设置 → 通用设置」里改，手改这个分区通常只在批量重置时用。

streamDensity.en: Display mode: detailed (each tool becomes a card) or concise (one line per tool).
streamDensity.zh: 显示模式：detailed（逐个工具成卡）或 concise（每个工具一行）。

defaultPermissionMode.en: Default permission tier for new sessions.
defaultPermissionMode.zh: 新会话的默认权限档位。

lastProviderId.en: Last used provider, used for pre-selection.
lastProviderId.zh: 上次用过的供应商，用于预选。

lastModelId.en: Last used model, used for pre-selection.
lastModelId.zh: 上次用过的模型，用于预选。

titleProviderId.en: Provider used to name new sessions; when unset, the first message is truncated instead.
titleProviderId.zh: 给新会话起标题所用的供应商；不填则截取首条消息。

titleModelId.en: Model used to name new sessions.
titleModelId.zh: 给新会话起标题所用的模型。

summary.en: Workspace registry. An array; each element is a workspace: `id` / `name` / `path` / `createdAt`. Normally added through the interface; hand edits are not recommended.
summary.zh: 工作区注册表。数组，每个元素是一项工作区：`id` / `name` / `path` / `createdAt`。日常通过界面添加，不建议手改。

summary.en: Model providers and their respective model lists. apiKey is stored encrypted in `apiKeyEnc`; the plaintext is never written to disk and never appears in any API response.
summary.zh: 模型供应商与各自的模型清单。apiKey 加密后存在 `apiKeyEnc`，明文不落盘、也不出现在任何接口响应里。

kind.en: `catalog` (built-in catalog, choose by model code) or `custom` (a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint); early records may lack this field and are treated as `custom` when read.
kind.zh: `catalog`（内置目录，按模型 code 选）或 `custom`（自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点）；早期记录可能没有这个字段，读时按 `custom` 处理。

id.en: Unique id of the provider on this machine.
id.zh: 供应商在本机的唯一 id。

piProvider.en: The built-in catalog identifier for a catalog provider.
piProvider.zh: catalog 供应商对应的内置目录标识。

baseURL.en: Overrides the address from the catalog; null means use the default.
baseURL.zh: 覆盖目录里的地址；null 表示用默认。

apiKeyEnc.en: The encrypted key. Typing plaintext by hand has no effect.
apiKeyEnc.zh: 加密后的密钥。手填明文无效。

protocol.en: Default wire protocol for this provider (can be overridden per model).
protocol.zh: 该供应商默认的线上协议（可被单个模型覆盖）。

auth.en: Custom authentication method (needed by a few providers).
auth.zh: 自定义鉴权方式（少量供应商需要）。

models.en: Model list: each item has `code`, and optionally `name` / `contextWindow` / `maxOutputTokens` / `reasoning` / `input` / `protocol`.

modelCodes.en: Older form: an array holding only model codes. Converted to `models` on read; new writes use `models`.
modelCodes.zh: 早期写法：只存模型 code 的数组。读取时会转成 `models`，新写入用 `models`。

summary.en: Model routing tier table. An array; each item is `{ id, label, description, target: { providerId, modelId } | null, reasoningEffort? }`; a `target` of null means unassigned, and dispatch falls back to the parent session's model.
summary.zh: 模型路由档位表。数组，每项为 `{ id, label, description, target: { providerId, modelId } | null, reasoningEffort? }`；`target` 为 null 表示未指派，派发时退回父会话的模型。

summary.en: Parameter-level permission rules. The array `rules` is matched in order and the first hit takes effect; rules can only tighten permissions, never cross the sandbox boundary.
summary.zh: 参数级权限规则。数组 `rules`，按顺序匹配，第一条命中生效；规则只能收紧权限，不能越过沙箱边界。

rules.en: Rule array. See the table below for each rule's fields.
rules.zh: 规则数组。每条规则的字段见下表。

toolPattern.en: Matches the tool name by wildcard pattern.
toolPattern.zh: 按通配模式匹配工具名。

capability.en: Matches a capability declared by the tool.
capability.zh: 按工具声明的能力匹配。

pathPattern.en: Matches by path — only applies to tools that declare a path argument, which does not include `bash`.
pathPattern.zh: 按路径匹配——只对声明了路径入参的工具生效，`bash` 不在其中。

hostPattern.en: Matches by URL host — only applies to tools that declare a URL argument.
hostPattern.zh: 按 URL 主机匹配——只对声明了 URL 入参的工具生效。

commandPrefix.en: Command prefix (matched token by token); only applies to tools that declare a command argument.
commandPrefix.zh: 命令前缀（逐 token 匹配），只对声明了命令入参的工具生效。

summary.en: Lifecycle hooks. Each key is a lifecycle name (`session:start`, `turn:end`, `preToolUse`, `postToolUse`, `userPromptSubmit`, `preCompact`, `subagentStop`, `notification` and so on), and the value is an array of command hooks, each item accepting only `{ "type": "command", "command": "…" }`.
summary.zh: 生命周期钩子。每个键是一个生命周期名（`session:start`、`turn:end`、`preToolUse`、`postToolUse`、`userPromptSubmit`、`preCompact`、`subagentStop`、`notification` 等），值是命令钩子数组，每项只接受 `{ "type": "command", "command": "…" }`。

summary.en: Language server configuration. The built-in set only covers TS/JS; register other languages here. An invalid configuration refuses to start rather than silently doing nothing.
summary.zh: 语言服务器配置。内置只覆盖 TS/JS；其他语言在这里登记。非法配置会拒绝启动，而不是静默失效。

servers.en: Indexed by **language id** (such as `typescript`, `python`), not by file extension; a file path is first mapped to a language id and then looked up in this table.
servers.zh: 按**语言 id** 索引（如 `typescript`、`python`），不是文件扩展名；文件路径先映射到语言 id 再查这张表。

initializationParams.en: Initialization parameters passed through to the language server.
initializationParams.zh: 透传给语言服务器的初始化参数。

summary.en: Network egress list. It constrains the three Network-port tools (`web_fetch` / `web_search` / `http_query`) and top-level navigation of the agent browser; it is not a machine-level firewall — curl run in bash and subresources inside browser pages do not go through it. The denylist wins, matching is by exact host name, and there are no wildcards.
summary.zh: 网络出口名单。约束 Network 端口的三个工具（`web_fetch` / `web_search` / `http_query`）以及 Agent 浏览器的顶层导航；不是机器级防火墙——bash 里跑的 curl 和浏览器页面内的子资源不经过它。denylist 优先，精确主机名匹配，无通配符。

allowHosts.en: List of host names allowed. **Writing this field switches to whitelist mode**: every host not on the list is rejected; `[]` means reject everything.
allowHosts.zh: 允许访问的主机名列表。**一旦写了这个字段就进入白名单模式**：不在名单里的主机全部拒绝；`[]` 表示拒绝全部。

denyHosts.en: List of host names to reject; takes precedence over allowHosts.
denyHosts.zh: 拒绝访问的主机名列表，优先于 allowHosts。

summary.en: Sidebar layout (pinned sessions, groups). Runtime state written by the interface; hand edits are overwritten on the next layout change.
summary.zh: 侧边栏布局（置顶会话、分组）。运行时状态，由界面写入，手改会在下次布局变更时被覆盖。

summary.en: The agent's built-in browser. It runs on the machine hosting the gateway and uses your locally installed Chrome/Chromium/Edge as the execution environment; Volto only depends on playwright-core as a driver and downloads no browser. It runs headless in the background by default and closes automatically once a turn ends.
summary.zh: Agent 内置浏览器。它跑在网关所在机器上，用你本机安装的 Chrome/Chromium/Edge 做执行环境；Volto 只依赖 playwright-core 驱动，不向仓库下载浏览器。默认后台无头运行，一个回合结束后自动关闭。

enabled.en: Whether to wire up the browser tools; defaults to true. For shared/remote deployments it is recommended to explicitly set it to false.
enabled.zh: 是否装配浏览器工具，默认 true。共享/远程部署建议显式设为 false。

headless.en: Whether to run headless; defaults to true (runs in the background and takes no window). Setting it to false pops up a real browser window; keep it true when there is no display environment.
headless.zh: 是否无头运行，默认 true（后台运行，不占用窗口）。设为 false 会弹出真实浏览器窗口；无显示环境请保持 true。

idleTimeoutMs.en: How long without tool calls before that session's browser is closed; defaults to 600000 (10 minutes).
idleTimeoutMs.zh: 无工具调用多久后关闭该会话的浏览器，默认 600000（10 分钟）。

storageStatePath.en: Optional path to a Playwright storage state file; new session browsers load it, and `browser_storage_state` writes to it. The file holds login cookies, so exclude it from git yourself.
storageStatePath.zh: 可选的 Playwright storage state 文件路径；新会话浏览器会加载它，`browser_storage_state` 会写入它。文件含登录 cookie，需自行排除出 git。

executablePath.en: Path to your local Chrome/Chromium/Edge executable. When unset, common install locations are probed automatically; if none is found the browser tools are disabled, and no browser is downloaded.
executablePath.zh: 你本机 Chrome/Chromium/Edge 的可执行文件路径。不设置时自动探测常见安装位置；找不到会禁用浏览器工具，不会下载浏览器。
